alex: quick heads-up — telemetry is showing repeated latency spikes when the sparse-batch routing path activates (route=shape-aware). saw it on canary this morning, 95th jumps ~120ms for some tenants. not sure if it's batching or an unexpected fallback. @sophia any idea?
sophia: saw that too. looks correlated with lots of tiny vectors (dim_count=16) + large payloads getting coalesced into sparse batches. Our op counts spike (kv_cache_hits drop) and we fall back to single-token kernel in a few cases. attaching logs shortly. :eyes:
alex: pasted log snippet: ```[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] tenant=acme route=shape-aware batch_size=3 total_vectors=48 avg_dim=16 kernel_path=sparse_v1 fallback=false latency_ms=13
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] tenant=acme route=shape-aware batch_size=1 total_vectors=80 avg_dim=16 kernel_path=single_token fallback=true latency_ms=132```
matt: ugh. that fallback jump looks like our cache miss policy + the prefetch de-dupe threshold. If prefetch is disabled it sometimes causes extra serialization into single huge payloads. We should verify if the prefetch window is being respected for mixed-shape batches.
jess: from a console/UX POV customers will see a blip in per-route p95 but not know why. Suggest adding a "sparse-batch activations" metric (counter) and a small chart in the model route page that shows fraction of requests routed to sparse path vs normal over time. also a rate-limited explanation tooltip.
sophia: agree on metrics. Proposed list: `sparse_activations_total`, `sparse_fallbacks_total`, `sparse_avg_batch_size`, `sparse_kernel_latency_p50/p95`. Also tag by `tenant_id` and `dim_bucket` (e.g., <=32, 33-128, >128).
alex: does anyone have concerns about telemetry cardinality? tagging by tenant + dim_bucket + route could explode. we need downstream storage limits in the console retention plan.
matt: keep dim_bucket coarse to limit cardinality. also emit a streaming sample event (1%) with full shape/payload for debugging instead of full-sampled telemetry. we already have sampling infra in `ingest-sample` topic.
jess: on rollout plan — feature flag `sparse_telemetry_v1` gated behind canary. push metrics first (no UI), wait 48h, then show the console widget opt-in for internal orgs. roll it to GA after 2 weeks if error rates are stable. also add a console toggle to show/hide the sampled traces (privacy).
alex: good. Implementation notes: engineer-facing API endpoints should be `POST /internal/telemetry/embed/sparse` and `GET /internal/telemetry/embed/sparse?tenant=...&bucket=...&window=1h`. keep payload small: counters + percentile sketches. For sampled traces push to S3 prefix `sparse-traces/YYYY/MM/DD/tenant/`.
sophia: I'll draft the exporter PR. one more ask: route logic should emit a debug flag in logs when fallback occurs: `sparse_fallback=true fallback_reason=kv_miss`. makes postmortems easier.
matt: I'll add prefetch window smoothing tweak — reduce de-dupe aggression for small-dim groups, flip by ff `prefetch_shape_v2` if canary is green.
jess: UX: the widget will have a small heatmap of dim buckets vs p95 and a legend explaining batching behavior + recommended knobs (prefetch window, prefer_quantized). Keep copy short.
eng-bot: deploy queued: canary: eng-platform-canary-2026-03-15-22 — includes `sparse_telemetry_v1` exporter only.
alex: thanks everyone. action items: sophia PR for exporter, matt prefetch tweak PR, jess console mockups by EOD, then roll canary. I'll follow up in incident channel if we see another spike. :thumbsup:
